summary.goal: Bench-led strength progression: push comp bench (priority lift), keep squat & sumo climbing on heavier backoff volume, and finally cap the pull-up RPE drift.
changes: Real loads: peaks anchored on your B3 log (squat 480×2 @8 → e1RM 512), not the old conservative sheet.

Backoff volume matched to your logged norm (not a flat guess): squat 4·4·4·3·3, sumo 3·3·3·2·3, comp bench 4·4·4·3·3 backoff sets W1–W5 — tapering one at the peak like you already do. Bench gets +1 as the priority lift.
Pull-up gets a HARD @8 cap and conservative loads (top BW+80×3) — deliberately breaking the @9+ drift. Earn weight with reps, don't add load until RPE drops.
Dip peaks W3 (BW+85), pulls back W4 so it doesn't stack with the comp-bench peak (horizontal-press overlap).
W1 opens @6–7 (not a deload) since B3 W5 was a real deload.
accessory_changes: NEW: Incline DB Press (D4) — upper-chest volume for the bench push; replaces Weighted Back Extension (erectors redundant with heavy sumo + 4-set backoff).
NEW: Hanging Leg Raise (D2) — direct core/bracing for squat & sumo; replaces Seated Leg Curl (posterior already hit by same-day Paused RDL).
ROTATION: Rear Delt Fly → Reverse Pec Deck (D3) — same rear-delt target, machine variant, shoulder-friendlier.
Everything else carries over from B3.
